title: ConnectorsCallParams
description:
`connectors.call`'s params (5.3): `{run_id, connector, tool, input}`, one call of the
connector's `tool` with `input`, made as the `watch` run `run_id` with no model turn.

connector.description: The connector, such as `claude.ai Slack`: the run's mount.

input.description:
The tool's input: the run's pinned call is its RFC 8785 SHA-256, and it is the very
input the call is made with.

run_id.description: The run the call is made as: a new lower-case UUID, the app's to pick.

tool.description: The tool, as Claude Code names it: `mcp__<connector as Claude Code writes it>__…`.
